headline: Your daily
Bible widget.
frames.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
frames.mission: Understand Bible + daily habit + phone widget in one glance.
frames.scenario: I reach for my iPhone during a busy day. A Bible verse is already installed as a widget on the Home Screen, among my app icons.
frames.proof: Supported native Home Screen widget with a short BSB verse and source. Installed widget remains visible behind a matching enlarged projection. Phone app icons establish the system Home Screen.
frames.visual: Dark warm first frame with 58px headline Your daily / Bible widget. A photorealistic antique brown leather Holy Bible forms the outside of a phone: gilt HOLY BIBLE title, page edges, inset black iPhone screen. Inside is a visible rounded Bible widget and app icon grid. A matching enlarged readable cream verse widget emerges forward from the book/phone. No marketing subtitle, footer or fine print. This is an editorial metaphor, not a physical product or a shipped leather skin.

headline: Worried?
Find a verse.
frames.verse: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
frames.mission: Show the input and useful result, then connect the result back to the widget.
frames.scenario: A worry keeps returning. I choose Anxious, read a relevant passage and keep it on my Lock Screen.
frames.proof: MainView statesSection → selection(forState:) → resultsSection → pin; 1PE.5.7 is ranked first for anxious in shipped content.
frames.visual: 58px Literata headlines, versus 45px in r3. Large phone and one enlarged action. First frame adds a small warm brown Holy Bible book behind the widget, as a source-of-content cue. No award badge. No marketing subtitles, footer labels, widget callout caption, night caption or small player caption. The large headline and product action carry meaning.

headline: Too tired?
Listen & pray.
frames.verse: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
frames.mission: Make audio immediately recognizable, connected to an evening Bible habit.
frames.scenario: At bedtime I want Scripture but am tired of reading. I open Tonight and play the verse and prayer.
frames.proof: TonightContent → ListenButton → AudioService; PSA.3.5 has a bundled BSB recording. Enlarged play control; no invented waveform or duration.
